title: Personal Pronouns (I, you, he, she, it, we, they) - Subject pronouns only

explanation.en: Use 'I' as the subject pronoun, not 'me' or 'mine'
explanation.ru: Используйте 'I' как подлежащее местоимение, а не 'me' или 'mine'
explanation.uz: 'I' ni ega olmoshi sifatida ishlating, 'me' yoki 'mine' emas

explanation.en: 'She' is the subject pronoun, and it takes 'likes' with third person singular
explanation.ru: 'She' — подлежащее местоимение; в 3-м лице ед. числа используется 'likes'
explanation.uz: 'She' ega olmoshi; 3-shaxs birlikda 'likes' ishlatiladi

explanation.en: Use 'He' as the subject pronoun when referring to a male person
explanation.ru: Используйте 'He' как подлежащее местоимение, когда говорите о мужчине
explanation.uz: Erkak kishi haqida gapirganda ega olmoshi sifatida 'He' ni ishlating

explanation.en: 'We' is the subject pronoun used for a group that includes the speaker
explanation.ru: 'We' — подлежащее местоимение для группы, включающей говорящего
explanation.uz: 'We' — gapiruvchini ham o‘z ichiga olgan guruh uchun ega olmoshi

explanation.en: 'They' is the subject pronoun for referring to multiple people or things
explanation.ru: 'They' — подлежащее местоимение для нескольких людей или предметов
explanation.uz: 'They' — bir nechta odam yoki narsalar uchun ega olmoshi

explanation.en: 'You' is used as both singular and plural subject pronoun
explanation.ru: 'You' используется как в единственном, так и во множественном числе
explanation.uz: 'You' yakka va ko‘plikda ham ishlatiladi

options.answer: The cat is hungry. Its is eating.
The cat is hungry. It is eating.
The cat is hungry. Its is eating food.

explanation.en: 'It' is the subject pronoun used for animals, objects, and things
explanation.ru: 'It' — подлежащее местоимение для животных, предметов и явлений
explanation.uz: 'It' hayvonlar, buyumlar va narsalar uchun ega olmoshi

options.answer: I and my sister are happy.
My sister and I are happy.
Me and my sister are happy.

explanation.en: When using 'I' with others, put 'I' last and use the subject form
explanation.ru: При сочетании с другими используйте 'I' в конце и в форме подлежащего
explanation.uz: Boshqalar bilan birga ishlatilganda, 'I' ni oxirida va ega shaklida qo‘llang

options.answer: She and he are working together.

explanation.en: Both 'she' and 'he' are subject pronouns and can be used together
explanation.ru: И 'she', и 'he' — подлежащие местоимения и могут использоваться вместе
explanation.uz: 'she' ham, 'he' ham ega olmoshlari; birgalikda ishlatilishi mumkin

options.answer: We go to school every day.
Us go to school every day.
Our go to school every day.

explanation.en: 'We' is the correct subject pronoun for a group including the speaker
explanation.ru: 'We' — правильное подлежащее местоимение для группы с «я»
explanation.uz: 'We' — gapiruvchi kiradigan guruh uchun to‘g‘ri ega olmoshi
